overview.description: The Schwab 1-5 Year Corporate Bond ETF (SCHJ) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Bloomberg US Corporate (1-5 Y) index. The fund tracks a market-weighted index of USD-denominated investment-grade corporate bonds with short-term maturities of 1-5 years. SCHJ was launched on Oct 10, 2019 and is issued by Charles Schwab.
